note: Items the contract needs but the extractor cannot see from the page struct: §1-required rows the baseline only declares in dead code (`specRequired`), and actions rendered by a sibling view struct (`baselineReachable: true`). Each keeps its `File.swift:line` provenance; the `spec-baseline-mismatch` check treats a `specRef` on an entry as the acknowledgement for that §1 entrance. A whole surface that the extractor does not generate at all is registered as its own hand-written contract instead (`pages/preview-surface.json`, see its `handRegistered` block): an entry here is merged into an extracted page, and there is no extracted page to merge into.
